job_title: Part Time Sales Associate (Ho Chi Minh City)
company_name: CÔNG TY TNHH APM MONACO VIỆT NAM
sub_category: Bán hàng trang sức đá quý; B2C; Direct Sales; Bán hàng tại cửa hàng/showroom

benefits: Global, Dynamic Team: Diverse and energetic workforce
Growth Opportunities: We support your professional development.

description:
Business Acumen (Sales, Customer Service, VM, Operations)
* Meet sales targets and KPIs, with a consistent and outstanding track record
* Provide the highest level of customer service through a custom-made approach
* Build and maintain long-term relationship with customers (CRM) by providing excellent customer experience
* Engage with Clients on latest trends in the fashion jewelry world and developments in jewelry market
* Show a deep enthusiasm for APM, especially all marketing and social media campaigns related to APM, the new APM Collections, and all pertinent marketing news around the company
* Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of APM products
* Maintain APM's standards on visual merchandizing (VM), checklist, and stock take in order to support the Store-in-charge on daily operations
* Comply with all APM retail operations guidelines and procedures
People
* Demonstrate work with integrity and respect for others
* Participate in a team environment; being always supportive and proposing effective solutions
* Understand the core values and culture of APM and reflect these in all efforts
requirements_text:
Requirements
* You love APM Monaco
* Minimum of 1 year of working experience in retail is preferred
* Supporting sales, store operation and visual merchandising
* Fluency in English & Mandarin would be a plus
* Teamwork spirit and proactive attitude
* Approachable personality and customer-service oriented
* Attractive and competitive package is offered (basic salary & commission)
* Working location: Ho Chi Minh City

Kỹ năng giao tiếp, Làm việc nhóm, Kỹ năng bán hàng, Chăm Sóc Khách Hàng
